events.did: found himself sitting in the classroom, gripping the edge of his desk, then splayed his hand over a different plane of wood
events.quote_anchor: One moment Victor was sitting in the classroom, gripping the edge of his desk, and the next his hand was splayed over a different plane of wood, ink smudging his fingertips.

events.did: sat at a bar off campus across from Eli, whose beers sat untouched on the table between them
events.quote_anchor: They were at the bar off campus, Eli across from him, his gaze guarded, searching. Their beers sat on the table between them, untouched.

events.did: told Victor that ExtraOrdinaries are real and that there is no scientific basis for anything until someone discovers it
events.quote_anchor: “There’s no scientific basis for anything,” Eli shot back, “not until someone discovers it.”

events.did: winced as something sharp cut into his palm and the bar flickered, putting him back in the amusement park
events.quote_anchor: As his hand tightened on the bottle, Victor winced. He didn’t feel the glass give way, but something sharp cut into his palm.

events.did: let go of the jagged metal pole, dulling his own pain on instinct, and the park vanished again
events.quote_anchor: He let go, dulling his own pain on instinct. A mistake. The moment he did, the park vanished again, instantly subsumed by the spell.

events.did: ratcheted his pain back up to banish the illusion and left the dials turned up to keep the spell from returning
events.quote_anchor: Victor ratcheted his pain back up, sharp enough to banish the illusion. Put him back on solid ground.

events.did: reached out, took hold of the agent’s nerves and pulled, making them lurch instead of buckle
events.quote_anchor: Victor didn’t hesitate. He reached out, took hold of the agent’s nerves, and pulled.

events.did: drew his gun and fired at the agent’s head, then fired two more shots into the center of their chest
events.quote_anchor: Victor drew his gun and fired at the agent’s head. The bullet ricocheted off the helmet, leaving the visor scraped but otherwise intact.

events.did: flicked the agent’s visor up, found an ordinary human face without terror, and put the gun between their eyes and fired
events.quote_anchor: Finding none, he put the gun between their eyes, and fired, the current dying as they fell.

events.did: drove his power into the three more agents with blunt force, blowing every fuse so they buckled and slumped to the ground
events.quote_anchor: He reached out, and instead of bothering with dials, he simply drove his power into them with sheer blunt force, blowing every fuse.

relations.did: told Victor he should be thanking him, because if Eli fails, top of class is Victor’s
relations.quote_anchor: “You should be thanking me, Vic. If I fail as spectacularly as you seem to think I will, top of class is yours.”

relations.did: said he wants to beat Eli because he is better, not because Eli is crazy
relations.quote_anchor: “I want to beat you because I’m better,” said Victor, reaching for his own beer. “Not because you’re crazy.”

relations.did: spoke to Victor through the comm, warning him that something was wrong and later that he has trouble
relations.quote_anchor: Mitch’s voice burst through the comm, strained with worry.

relations.who: The agent in black tactical gear
relations.did: address Victor by name and tried to take him alive with a dart instead of a bullet
relations.quote_anchor: They were trying to take him alive.

numbers.did: half of his strength — what it took just to hold the agent still while he walked toward them
numbers.quote_anchor: It took half of Victor’s strength just to hold them still while he walked toward them, flicking the visor up.

numbers.did: two more shots — the rounds he fired into the center of the agent’s chest after the first ricocheted off the helmet
numbers.quote_anchor: He dropped the sight and fired two more shots into the center of their chest.

numbers.did: three more agents — he heard their boots on broken earth and turned to find each approaching from a different side
numbers.quote_anchor: he heard their boots on broken earth, and turned to find three more agents, each approaching from a different side.

numbers.did: one figure — the agent in black tactical gear, helmet on and visor down, who came toward him
numbers.quote_anchor: One figure, in black tactical gear, helmet on and visor down.
